messages:
alex_k: FYI we have a customer in trial hitting 403s after our last SAML attribute-rollout. They say role bindings didn't map and billing shows a short spike of noise. ticket #CS-7842 :grimacing:

marta_s: Which attributes changed? did we flip to `eduPersonPrincipalName` or change the wildcard mapping?

alex_k: We switched the SCIM->RBAC mapping so `group` -> `redwood_role` is now strict. Looks like some AD groups came back with different casing. Error sample from their logs: `permission denied: rolebinding not found for user: user@example.com`

devin_r: Can you paste the repro steps? I want to check our provisioning job logs and the SCIM delta.

alex_k: Steps I ran locally: 1) SAML login -> SCIM sync runs -> API requests to /v1/engines/text return 403 for that user. 2) On the Customer's tenant, `GET /admin/rolebindings?user=user@example.com` returns empty.

priya_g: Also noticed audit export for that tenant is missing recent `kms:decrypt` entries. Might explain the billing anomaly because retries bounced to fallback and retried tokens.

ben_ops: Reproduced quickly. In our audit logs I see: `scim.sync: delta={\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/members/0/displayName\",\"value\":\"Engineering\"}`

ben_ops: Also `rbac.apply: converted_groups=[\"engineering\"] -> roles=[\"developer\"]` then `rbac.apply: skipped_group=Engineering` (note different case)

marta_s: So SCIM is returning groups with original case, but our mapping expects lowercase. Why didn't the normal normalization run?

devin_r: There was a hotfix yesterday that adjusted trimming logic in scim-normalize. It only lowercases when `group_normalize=strict`. Tenant was on `group_normalize=legacy` after migration.

alex_k: Customer's side: their IdP emits groups like `Engineering`, `engineering` (duplicate group names with different case). SCIM merged them into separate entries, RBAC dedupe ran against normalized lowercase and only one mapped. The other mapping was dropped.

priya_g: About the missing `kms:decrypt` audit lines — audit-bot: export status for tenant ct-998 shows `last_export=1967102000`, `pending_entries=120`, `error=ENCRYPTION_TEMPORARY`

audit-bot: automated note: KMS HSM gateway returned transient 503, retried 3x, queued for manual replay. See ops ticket O-2121.

ben_ops: That explains billing noise — requests retried via fallback path incremented token counters before final failure. We should pause billing or credit them for the retry spike.

marta_s: Mitigation steps to propose: 1) Rollback strict mapping to `group_normalize=legacy` for that tenant. 2) Re-run SCIM full sync with case-insensitive dedupe. 3) Replay audit export after KMS replay fixed. 4) Issue one-time credit for the spike.

devin_r: I can push a scoped configuration change: `PATCH /admin/tenants/ct-998/config {"group_normalize":"legacy"}`. Will run in canary at 1967102800.

alex_k: Customer updated, they requested logs and a clear timeline. Can we assemble: root cause, timeline, what changed in the SAML attribute rollout, and mitigation + compensation?

priya_g: I'll draft the timeline. Quick notes: 1967099000 deploy: scim-normalize hotfix. 1967101000 config rollout: default `group_normalize` became `strict`. 1967102000 first 503 from HSM. 1967102468 customer report.

ben_ops: After canary change, I'll re-run `POST /admin/tenants/ct-998/scim/sync?full=true` and watch `rbac.apply` logs.

marta_s: Also add check to our SCIM CI to catch case-duplicate groups. Add unit test for duplicate group names differing only by case.

alex_k: Thanks all. I'll update ticket CS-7842 with mitigation and cc billing for credit.

ben_ops: Done the canary patch at 1967102805. Logs show `rbac.apply: converted_groups=[\"Engineering\",\"engineering\"] -> roles=[\"developer\",\"developer\"]` and `duplicate_normalized=1`

alex_k: Customer confirms access restored at 1967102797 :tada:

marta_s: Follow-ups: - audit replay ticket O-2121 priority. - add retention check to make sure `kms:decrypt` entries surface. - billing to confirm credit issued.

priya_g: Draft ready for CS-7842: root cause, timeline, actions, credits, follow-ups. Ready for review.

alex_k: looks good. I'll send to customer and close after billing confirmation.
